decisions.reason: The cancellation does not modify the specified gameplay sequence or make any of its attributes stale; shared membership in the video deliverable is insufficient for a propagated MODIFY.
The source reports general script nonadherence and cancellation but does not revise the required phone-message opening action or placement.
The source does not change whether the opening and gameplay must use the same phone, and no candidate attribute depends on exact spoken-script adherence.
The script-adherence removal does not change the specified language or video count; the contract-cancellation language does not entail an attribute-level MODIFY here.
Cancellation does not establish a duration value or resolve the script-completeness versus duration tradeoff on its merits, so no supported MODIFY can be propagated.
